item.title: 原来达里奥切除过睾丸，很少有人知道
item.description:
Anthropic 的达里曾经得过睾丸癌。2014 年，他确诊后接受化疗，最终完全康复。这段经历此前鲜为人知。

《纽约时报》 2026 年 11 月 5 日左右的深度报道（ Ryan Mac 等）首次较详细公开了这件事。报道称，两名认识他的人透露，Dario Amodei 在 2014 年被诊断出睾丸癌，当时他在斯坦福做癌症细胞相关博士后研究。他接受了化疗，最终完全康复。

早期睾丸癌（主要指 I 期）治疗标准第一步切除一侧睾丸。治愈率超过 95%。剩下一侧通常能维持生育和睾酮。多数人仍可自然生育。

化疗：常导致暂时不育。多数人 1-2 年后恢复精子生成，5 年时约 80%恢复。少数永久受损。 RPLND：可能损伤射精神经，导致逆行射精（精液进膀胱）。

item.title: giffgaff 退款了兄弟们，被封了大半年试着去投诉，没解封但是退款了
item.description:
直接原路退款，邮件内容如下：

Dear ,

Thank you for reaching out to us and for your patience whilst we have reviewed this matter.

Having further considered the relevant circumstances of your case we confirm that your SIM will remain disconnected. However, we are approving your request for a refund. I can confirm that we are processing a refund back to your original payment method. Please note, only the remaining credit that was directly purchased by yourself is eligible for this refund.

You should see these funds reflected in your account within 3–5 business days.

Keeping your number
If you would like to keep your number you will need to generate a PAC code and provide this to another UK network. Alternatively, a STAC code can be used to move to another UK network without your number. Further guidance for these can be found here.

Best Regards,
giffgaff team
